correctness.rationale: For all fixed m>=1, factor the exact integer difference into two positive opposite-parity factors. The odd part and gcd force the even factor to be divisible by 2m/d, giving the lower bound d+2m/d. Complementary factors attain it, with exact difference m. Two distinct odd divisors tying would have odd product 2m, impossible; equality fixes the unique earlier witness. Prime-power minimizers follow from explicit one-step differences. Exact independent residue enumeration through m=9999 supports the proof, not the quantifiers.
